title: ai-therapist mbench seed rows
subtitle: Partial Qwen3-4B MentalBench-100k baseline rows
description: Seed rows for the vLLM rerun of the MentalBench-100k Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 baseline (eval/mbench_baseline). output_shard_a.csv (906 rows, idx 0-905) and output_shard_b.csv (875 rows, idx 5000-5874) were generated by the earlier single-stream shard kernels on T4 with the same model, prompt and sampling params; the vLLM kernel copies them into its output instead of regenerating them. MentalBench-100k itself comes from https://github.com/abeerbadawi/MentalBench-Align.
